main.description: Retract an active local removal after review. Instance authority and actor identity come from the authenticated service context, never request fields. An imported source's decision cannot be targeted and returns InvalidDecision.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; authenticate with an authorized service account before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The authenticated actor lacks permission; do not retry unless its moderation authority changes.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request is incomplete, including a missing reviewedSubject when a current record exists; correct it before retrying.

errors.name: DecisionNotFound
errors.description: The referenced local removal does not exist; refetch getSubjectState before choosing an action to retry.

errors.name: InvalidDecision
errors.description: The target is not an active local removal; select a valid local decision before retrying.

errors.name: ContentChanged
errors.description: The reviewed subject CID changed; refetch getSubjectState and re-inspect the current content before retrying.

errors.name: StateConflict
errors.description: expectedVersion is stale; refetch getSubjectState before retrying with the new version.

errors.name: IdempotencyConflict
errors.description: The same key was reused with a different request; do not retry with that key.

errors.name: UnsupportedReason
errors.description: The reason is not supported for this action; choose a supported reason before retrying.

errors.name: ModerationUnavailable
errors.description: The moderation service is temporarily unavailable; retry later.

input.description: Request to retract an active local removal decision

actionId.description: Opaque identifier of the local removal to retract; the service qualifier is implicit

expectedVersion.description: Opaque subject-state version expected by the caller

idempotencyKey.description: Opaque key that makes equivalent restoration requests idempotent

reason.description: Public reason classification for restoring the subject

reviewedSubject.description: Inspected current record; required when one exists and allowed absent when deleted or unavailable

privateNote.description: Private administrative note retained only on the admin action
